description: Arcadia GUI runtime ladder: source sync, cargo build, binary promote, systemd, health, and source SHA state.

managed_files.content:
[Unit]
Description=Arcadia appliance GUI
After=network.target caduceus.service

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/arcadia
Restart=on-failure
AmbientCapabilities=CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE
CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE
Environment=CADUCEUS_HTTP_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:8787
Environment=ARCADIA_TLS_CERT=/var/lib/arcadia/tls/chain.pem
Environment=ARCADIA_TLS_KEY=/var/lib/arcadia/tls/key.pem
Environment=ARCADIA_HTTPS_BIND=0.0.0.0:443

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
